title: REQ · App emits interact animation and transition events from game actions
summary: App forwards game actions to Phaser through reactToPhaser
description: Context: App passes game.act to ActionMenu and game.choose to StoryPanel without telling Phaser. Desired behavior: after an object action App emits playAnimation {target:'boy',name:'interact'}, and when the action changes the active scene id it emits transitionTo. Expected result: unit tests show the events are emitted from game actions. Why: the screen reacts to gameplay.
acceptance_criteria: Given the playing view, when an ActionMenu action is chosen, then reactToPhaser emits playAnimation with target boy and name interact
Given a game action that changes the scene id, when it completes, then reactToPhaser emits transitionTo with the new sceneId
Given an action that leaves the scene id unchanged, when it completes, then no transitionTo is emitted

in_scope: Scene id change detection from game state

technical_constraints: Do not mock the store in unit tests of state change
definition_of_done: App emits both events from the action handler
